description: 🐸 AmphiCore Labs 🔬 is a two-person team from Dushanbe, Tajikistan, taking part in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Jonathan Sharifi leads web development, interface design, and prototyping. Benjamin Abdulaev researches NASA resources and analyzes scientific information. Together, we’re building LUNASHIFT, a lunar mission trainer where students manage limited resources and replay a mission to see how one decision changes the outcome.
